user.title: Create a Garmin profile
user.description: Choose the entities this profile can read. Each profile gets an independent token.

confirm.title: Copy the access token
confirm.description: The token is shown only once. To copy it completely, focus the field below, then use Select All and Copy (Ctrl+A / Ctrl+C or Cmd+A / Cmd+C). Do not modify the token. It cannot be recovered later.

error.token_modified: The token was modified. Copy the original value and try again.

abort.invalid_setup: The setup flow expired. Start again.
